text:
Type: tab-top curtains with tie-backs, pair
Use: dressing a window, softening daylight, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, farmhouse
Materials: woven cotton fabric with a soft slub texture, matching fabric tie-backs
Colors: medium cool grey
Shape: two full-length straight panels hung from wide fabric tabs on a rod, gathered at mid-height by tie-back straps into an hourglass drape, soft vertical folds, medium visual weight
Feel: calm, soft, homely, relaxed
Goes with: white walls, light wood, linen upholstery, grey or blue textiles; Scandinavian, farmhouse or minimalist rooms

product.name: LENDA
product.description: The curtains lower the general light level and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing directly into the room.
